title: Move to design-system components
description:
UI is built from ad-hoc, screen-local components—the same button or cell reimplemented many times, drifting in style and behavior. We’re consolidating onto a shared design-system component library:

  • One source of truth — shared tokens and components instead of copies.
  • Consistent look — the same component behaves the same everywhere.
  • App-wide restyle — tweak a component once and every screen updates, so refreshing the UI stays cheap.
  • Faster assembly — build screens from ready-made components.
  • Component sandbox — designers see every component in one place, poke them, and toggle states.
